name: dispensa
description: Dispensa di casa — app web/mobile con login Google, sync Firestore e integrazione Alexa

scripts.build:android: npm run build && npx cap sync android && find android/app/src/main/res -name '* *' -delete; cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug --no-daemon && cd .. && cp android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk "$HOME/Desktop/Dispensa.apk" && echo '✅ APK pronto: ~/Desktop/Dispensa.apk'
scripts.build:android:release: npm run build && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease --no-daemon && cd .. && cp android/app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk "$HOME/Desktop/Dispensa.apk"
scripts.build:ios: npm run build && npx cap sync ios && npx cap open ios
scripts.check: node --check tests/sandbox.js && node -e "require('./tests/sandbox.js').loadSandbox(); console.log('index.html inline JS: OK')"
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync
scripts.cap:android: npm run build && npx cap sync android && npx cap open android
scripts.cap:ios: npm run build && npx cap sync ios && npx cap open ios
